text:
Maya (sales): Heads-up - prospect 'Europay Financial' asking for strict EU-only residency for a POC. No US egress, telemetry must stay in EU, BYOK required, and they want audit exports for 24 months. Need a concise handoff doc for their procurement team by Tue.
Owen (se): Quick check - BYOK import format + HSM requirement? They said FIPS/HSM.
Priya (eng): We support BYOK with HSM-backed keys. For Hosted we can use our EU KMS (eu-west-1) but for full BYOK HSM import they prefer Dedicated or Private so keys live in the customer's KMS/HSM.
Marco (sre): Subprocessor note - compute/storage run in EU regions (GCP eu-west1, AWS eu-central-1, Azure northeurope). Monitoring agents default to a SaaS vendor in the US (Datadog) unless we toggle EU-only telemetry. For POC we can disable US telemetry and route to EU-only observability.
InfraBot: Created ticket #6120 - "europay-poc-geo-lock". Owner: Priya (eng). ETA: 48h for checklist.
Sofia (legal): Please attach the subprocessors export and DPA redline expectations. Also confirm data deletion workflow and evidence (deletion receipts) and whether audit logs include full request/response metadata.
Maya (sales): They'll also ask about VPC peering and DB replicas. Can we support peering into eu-central-1 and keep DB standby in eu-west-1 only?
Priya (eng): Yes - VPC peering supported. Cross-region DB replicas are optional; we can keep replicas inside EU only. Important: avoid global control plane options that replicate metadata to non-EU control planes; use EU-only control plane for this POC.
Owen (se): Drafting a one-pager with: routing policy example, KMS/BYOK options, subprocessors link, telemetry toggle steps, VPC peering checklist, and a ballpark POC quote. Will post to Drive.
Maya (sales): Ballpark pricing? Need to put something in the RFP now.
Owen (se): Rough POC estimate: 2-week eval + 2-week staging = ~$18k total (includes reserved burst capacity, EU KMS, and telemetry isolation). If they want Dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv) add ~$12k/mo. Will firm after perf numbers.
Marco (sre): FYI perf note - if tenant pinned to eu-central-1 and failover to eu-north-1 (Stockholm), include latency penalty test. Schedule perf window with their infra.
Maya (sales): Can someone paste a sample routing payload we can include?
Priya (eng): Sample (for SE docs):
```json
{
  "tenant": "europay-poc",
  "routing": {
    "mode": "pin",
    "primary_region": "eu-central-1",
    "failover_regions": ["eu-west-1"],
    "egress_policy": "restrict_to_allowed_regions"
  },
  "kms": {
    "mode": "BYOK",
    "key_location": "customer-kms-eu-west-1",
    "hsm_required": true
  }
}
```
Owen (se): Also adding curl snippet for quick SE test:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"europay-poc","routing":{"primary":"eu-central-1","failover":["eu-west-1"]},"kms":{"type":"BYOK","region":"eu-west-1"}}'
```
Sofia (legal): Can we confirm audit export retention 24 months? Our default is 12 months for hosted. If they need 24 months we'll capture that as an addendum and mention storage location (EU).
Priya (eng): We can offer 24 months for the POC as a contractual exception; ops will enable EU-only log archiving.
Marco (sre): Note re: telemetry - to avoid any US transfers we must disable third-party alerting integrations and route metrics to EU-only datastore. Ops ticket created above covers that.
Maya (sales): I'll request their CIDR ranges and security contact for peering. Also collecting SIG and procurement timeline.
Owen (se): Uploading initial one-pager + price sketch to https://drive.redwood/POC/Europay-v2. I'll include the subprocessors export snapshot and a short checklist for ops handoff.
Maya (sales): Great, target to ship RFP response by Tue COB. Thanks team! :pray:
Priya (eng): +1. Will follow up on ticket and post implementation notes in the ops ticket.
